suggestion.to: Our Centre for Electronic Imaging (CEI) is working with partners worldwide to design and test graded-Z shielding for NewAthena’s Wide Field Imager: layers of heavy and light materials that block high-energy particles and the secondary radiation they produce. We model how the shielding will perform in orbit with the GEANT4 toolkit, checked against real detector tests.
